ui_bugs.issue: After selecting the 'Custom…' option in the Select, the Popover for from/to date inputs never renders in the DOM. data-testid='dashboard-range-custom-popover|custom-from|custom-to|custom-apply' all return count=0. Root cause: the Radix Popover uses an empty <span/> as its PopoverTrigger and is opened programmatically via setOpen(true) inside handleSelect — but the Select dropdown closing seems to immediately close the Popover (focus/portal race). Suggest using DialogTrigger asChild on a real anchor (e.g. the SelectTrigger) or use a Dialog instead of Popover with no anchor.

rca of the issue: Custom-range popover defect: RangePicker has Popover trigger as empty <span/> with open state set via setOpen(true) inside Select.onValueChange. When the Select's dropdown closes its overlay, focus returns and Radix Popover's outside-click logic (or the Select portal unmount) causes the Popover to close before render is committed, leaving no DOM nodes for the date inputs. Fix: anchor the Popover to the SelectTrigger using <PopoverAnchor asChild> wrapping the trigger, OR swap Popover for Dialog (modal), OR delay setOpen(true) one tick after the Select closes (e.g. setTimeout(()=>setOpen(true), 0)).
